# S3.9 — tool protocol edges — run ledger

- **Ticket**: `docs/tickets/055_S3.9__tool-protocol-edges.md` (sequence 55 of 106).
- **Branch**: `svitali/harnessharness-s3.9` (base `svitali/harnessharness-s3.8`).
- **Scope**: `import_listing`/`refresh` for `mcp_listing`; `sync_source`/
  deltas/`freeze`/`unavailable`; the MCP stdio client (dual era,
  probe-first) and stateless server; `ProtocolBinding`; the E5 battery;
  the `attribution_completeness` veto; helper-overhead distributions; the
  minimal profiles' `edit_file` shapes as primitive functions.
- **Acceptance criteria**: AC-R-2.5.1-{4–6,9,11,12},
  AC-R-2.5.2-{6,7,11}, AC-R-2.5.3-{4–7,9}, AC-R-2.5.4-{1–4,8,9,11,12};
  `removability(0…3)` unchanged.
- **Merge policy**: OPERATOR.

## Plan

Existing ground (surveyed before implementation): `hh-mcp` already serves
`hh-mcp-target/1` statelessly over newline JSON-RPC (`initialize`,
`server/discover`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `ping`); `hh-compiler`
owns `lower_target(mcp)` + `lift(mcp)` + `catalog_delta`/`freeze`/
`adopt`; `hh-registry` quarantines `mcp_listing`-sourced capabilities;
`hh-eval` already declares the `attribution_completeness` metric/veto;
`hh-telemetry` registers `harness_overhead_share`/`boundary_overhead_ms`.

This ticket adds the protocol-edge layer on top:

1. `hh-mcp::protocol` — `ProtocolBinding`, `Era`, `NegotiateError`
   (`ProtocolVersionMismatch`/`RequiredExtensionUnsupported`/
   `PeerUnreachable`), the pinned version set
   (`2026-07-28` modern, `2025-06-18` legacy), the omitted→`unknown`
   capability reconcile (ADR-0099 N3).
2. `hh-mcp::client` — `McpClient` over a line transport: probe-first
   `server/discover`, compatibility-probe fallback into the legacy era,
   bounded paginated `tools/list` (`IndexOverflow` on cursor faults),
   `call_tool` → `ToolOutcome{observed | paused(input_required) |
   failed | protocol_error | unknown}`, `import_listing`/`refresh`
   producing the pinned `SurfaceDocument` + `LiftReport` +
   `surface_name → (server_ref, semantic_id)` map (ADR-0097 D6).
3. `hh-mcp` server — `supportedVersions` on `server/discover`,
   `ttlMs`/`cacheScope`/`resultType` on `tools/list`,
   `resultType: "input_required"` + opaque `requestState` echo,
   `notifications/tools/list_changed` on bundle change, a `--legacy`
   era mode (no `server/discover`, legacy version) for the dual-era AC.
4. `hh-registry::import` — `import_listing`/`refresh` ops: lifted
   declarations register `quarantined` at `unverified` with
   `unknown_domain` honesty effects, `pin` over `listing_hash` raises
   (never transfers), `refresh` mints `supersedes{edit}` versions with
   surface-vs-semantic classification.
5. `hh-compiler::exposure` — the `sync_source` driver (listing →
   `CatalogEntry`s → `catalog_delta` → `adopt`) so all six triggers run
   the same path.
6. `hh-compiler` E5 battery — every `SurfaceFailure` class renders
   pairwise-distinguishably under each minimal profile.
7. `hh-embed` — `lab.registry.import` live dispatch (AC-R-2.5.1-11).
8. `hh-eval`/`hh-telemetry` — `attribution_completeness` wired into the
   suite verdict path; `harness_overhead.execution_ms` registered +
   per-(executor_class × isolation_class) distribution helper.
